name: Sinhagad Fort
tagline: Pune's closest fort trek — site of Tanaji Malusare's famous 1670 battle
seoTitle: Sinhagad Fort Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Sinhagad Fort — Pune's most accessible fort trek, history, season, safety, and packing.

seasons.label: Oct – Feb
seasons.sub: Clear views over Pune, comfortable climbing weather

seasons.label: Mar – May
seasons.sub: Hot, best done very early morning

routeOptions.name: Standard trekking path
routeOptions.duration: 45 min – 1.5 hrs up, 30 min – 1 hr down
routeOptions.notes: Well-trodden, popular with Pune locals as a regular fitness climb, not just a one-off trek.

safety.intro: Sinhagad is Pune's default fort trek — heavily used, well-marked, and low-risk, though the road up also carries vehicle traffic to be aware of near the top.

cards.title: Before you go
items: A road also runs to the top — you'll share some paths with vehicles near the summit
Very crowded on weekends; go on a weekday for a quieter solo trek

cards.title: On the trail
items: Trail is well-marked and heavily trafficked — easy to self-navigate
Famous for kanda bhaji (onion fritters) stalls at the top — carry small cash

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: One of the safest solo options on this list — busy year-round, close to Pune
Good starter trek before attempting more remote Sahyadri forts

items.name: Light layer — cooler at the top than in Pune city
Small cash for food stalls at the summit
